summary: The agent provides a comprehensive pipeline with good feature engineering and cross-validation, but suffers from multiple critical data leakage issues. Imputation, text feature extraction (TF-IDF/SVD), frequency encoding, and group aggregations are all performed on the concatenated train and test data before splitting.
